name: opentune_get_status
title: Get OpenTune status
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): reports whether this server can use OpenTune now, as one state (READY, NOT_READY, PROTOCOL_MISMATCH, STARTING, RUNNING_WITHOUT_API, NOT_RUNNING, NO_API_BUILD, NOT_INSTALLED, WSL_UNSUPPORTED_RUNTIME) with a nextStep saying who should do what. Call it first, and again whenever a tool error says so. Lists the running instances with their instance_id; when several run, ask the user which one to use. Read-only: it never starts, stops or changes OpenTune.

instance_id.description: Report only this instance (32 hex digits, from an earlier result). Omit to report all.

name: opentune_get_project
title: Get OpenTune project
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): reads the open project: path and unsaved-changes flag, tracks (volume, mute, solo), clips with timeline start, end and source file, a summary of each clip content (analysis state, key, note count, pitch shift), the selection and the transport. Every clip carries a clip_revision and the result an arrangement_revision: pass them as expected_revision to write tools. track_ids limits the result to those tracks; include_history adds the undo and redo tops. Read-only.

track_ids.description: Only these tracks and their clips (0-based track ids; positions, they shift when a track is deleted).

include_history.description: Also return the tops of the undo and redo histories. Default false.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_get_notes
title: Get OpenTune notes
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): lists the notes of one clip in start-time order, a page at a time (default 100, at most 200, fewer when large). Each note has its index, start and end seconds on the content clock and, for a placement, the timeline clock, detected and target MIDI pitch, offset in cents, retune speed (0 natural to 1 mechanical), vibrato and voiced / corrected flags. clock picks the clock of from and to; timeline needs a placement id. output_path saves all notes of the range to a new .json file (for the beat-grid skill) and returns a summary. OpenTune is not changed.

clip.description: Clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project, or a content id (c:...).

clock.description: Clock of from and to: content = seconds of the source audio, timeline = seconds of the arrangement (placement ids only). Required.

from.description: Range start in seconds on the given clock. Give both from and to.

to.description: Range end in seconds on the given clock. Notes overlapping the range.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, passed back unchanged.

output_path.description: Absolute path of a new .json file for all notes of the range, read page by page for you; leave out cursor and limit. The folder must exist. Never overwrites: a taken name gets " (2)", " (3)" ...

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_get_job
title: Get OpenTune job
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): reports a long-running job (import, export, analysis, project open or save): state queued, running, succeeded, failed or cancelled, progress, and when it has ended its result or error. With wait_seconds it waits up to that long for the job to end. Finished jobs are kept for 30 minutes. Read-only.

job_id.description: Job id from the result that started the job (j:...).

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end before answering, 0 to 30. Default 0: answer at once.

instance_id.description: Instance that owns the job. Optional: the job id identifies it.

name: opentune_cancel_job
title: Cancel OpenTune job
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): asks OpenTune to stop a running job and reports the outcome. Work the job already committed stays: an import keeps the items imported so far, and the result lists them with how to revert each; an export never touches the target file. Project saves, preference changes and project opens past their preparation cannot be cancelled; the error then says so and the job continues.

job_id.description: Job id from the result that started the job (j:...).

instance_id.description: Instance that owns the job. Optional: the job id identifies it.

name: opentune_launch
title: Start OpenTune
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): starts the OpenTune build configured for this server (OPENTUNE_MCP_OPENTUNE_PATH) with its control API and waits up to 30 seconds until it is ready, then reports the state like opentune_get_status, with a nextStep. Starts nothing when OpenTune already runs (alreadyRunning), may run without the control API, or no API build is configured; the result says why. Repeated or concurrent calls share one start. allow_second_instance needs the user's explicit consent; each call with it starts one more instance once earlier starts are done. Never closes OpenTune.

allow_second_instance.description: Start OpenTune even though an instance with the control API runs, or even though this server cannot list the running processes to rule out an OpenTune without the control API. Only when the user explicitly asked for a second instance, or confirmed that no OpenTune runs. Default false: start nothing then.

name: opentune_quit
title: Quit OpenTune
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): closes OpenTune like the window's close button and waits until it has exited. Unlike the window, it never closes silently over unsaved changes: it fails with UNSAVED_CHANGES. Then write a copy with opentune_save_project (mode autosave) and ask the user to save or to give the changes up; pass discard_unsaved: true only when the user explicitly agreed to lose them (cannot be undone). Refuses while a dialog is open or a job runs. Use when the user says they are done, not for a pause. Start OpenTune again with opentune_launch.

discard_unsaved.description: true only when the user explicitly agreed to lose the unsaved changes. Default false.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_set_clip
title: Set OpenTune clip key and pitch shift
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): sets the key (root and scale) and/or the pitch shift (whole semitones plus cents) of a clip. The key change cannot be undone (as in OpenTune); the result gives the opentune_set_clip call that restores the previous key. The pitch shift is one undo step; it does not transpose the key. With both, two requests run, key first, and the result reports each. Needs the clip_revision as expected_revision; only the key part of it is checked. The result returns the new clip_revision. Setting the current value changes nothing.

clip.description: Clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project, or a content id (c:...).

expected_revision.description: The clip_revision of the clip from opentune_get_project, opentune_get_notes or the last write result for it, passed back unchanged.

key.description: The clip key to set. Not undoable; the result gives the way back.

root.description: Tonic pitch class: 0 = C, 1 = C sharp ... 11 = B.

pitch_shift.description: Pitch shift to set: whole semitones -24..24 plus cents -99..99. Undoable.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_autotune_range
title: Auto-tune a range of an OpenTune clip
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): runs AUTO on a clip with an explicit mode. regenerate rebuilds notes in ranges from the sung pitch, snapped to scale; snapNotes moves existing note targets to scale; notesOnly replaces ALL notes, cannot be undone, needs replace_edited_notes true. Ranges: source-audio seconds, default whole clip, max 16, one undo step. Unset parameters use generator defaults, not window knobs. retune_speed 0..1: 0 keeps natural movement, 1 sounds mechanical.

clip.description: Clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project, or a content id (c:...).

expected_revision.description: The clip_revision of the clip from opentune_get_project, opentune_get_notes or the last write result for it, passed back unchanged.

scale.description: Key to snap to, or "clip" for the clip key. Needed by regenerate and snapNotes.

root.description: Tonic pitch class: 0 = C, 1 = C sharp ... 11 = B.

retune_speed.description: 0 keeps natural pitch movement, 1 is mechanical.

vibrato_depth.description: Added vibrato; 100 is plus or minus a semitone.

dry_run.description: Predict the changes without applying them.

replace_edited_notes.description: Only with the explicit consent of the user: lets notesOnly replace all notes, irreversibly.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_edit_notes
title: Edit OpenTune notes
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): edits existing notes of a clip as the piano roll does; never adds or removes notes. ops (1-32, in order, one undo step): setTargetPitch, shiftCents, snapToScale, setParams (retune_speed 0..1: 0 keeps the natural pitch movement, 1 sounds mechanical; vibrato; pitch_drift_scale). Each op selects notes; selections refer to the notes at expected_revision. dry_run previews.

clip.description: Clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project, or a content id (c:...).

expected_revision.description: The clip_revision of the clip from opentune_get_project, opentune_get_notes or the last write result for it, passed back unchanged.

delta_cents.description: Cents to raise (+) or lower (-) the target pitch; 100 = a semitone.

root.description: Tonic pitch class: 0 = C, 1 = C sharp ... 11 = B.

retune_speed.description: How far the pitch is pulled to the target note: 0 keeps the natural movement, 1 sounds mechanical.

vibrato_depth.description: Synthetic vibrato added on top, 100 = plus or minus a semitone; default 0.

vibrato_rate_hz.description: Speed of the added vibrato, Hz.

pitch_drift_scale.description: Scales the voice's own pitch wobble (the usual meaning of vibrato in a request): 1 keeps it, below 1 weakens it, 0 removes it.

ops.description: Each op has select. select = {indices:[...]} (from opentune_get_notes), {from_sec,to_sec} (source-audio seconds, overlapping), {all:true}, or {off_target_cents_over:N, from_sec?, to_sec?} (voiced notes whose sung pitch is more than N cents from their target). Every condition is evaluated on the notes at expected_revision, before any op runs, so an earlier op does not change what a later condition selects.

dry_run.description: Predict the changes without applying them.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_undo
title: Undo the top OpenTune step
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): undoes the step on top of the undo history, but only if it is the step undo_id names; otherwise UNDO_CONFLICT, and then ask the user (the history has changed). Only edits that reported an undo id can be undone. A step that changes nothing still uses up the undo step and marks the project changed (UNDO_NO_EFFECT). Clip split, merge and delete cannot be undone safely in some builds (undo_unsafe_build). The result gives the opentune_redo call that takes this back.

undo_id.description: The undo id (u:...) of the step you expect on top, from the write result that made it.

force.description: Only when the user explicitly asked to undo or redo a change that was not made through this server: applies the top step whatever it is. Never set it to get past UNDO_CONFLICT on your own.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_redo
title: Redo the top OpenTune step
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): redoes the step on top of the redo history, but only if it is the step undo_id names (the id the undo result reported); otherwise UNDO_CONFLICT, and then ask the user. Any edit without an undo entry made after the undo clears the redo history. A step that changes nothing still uses up the redo step (UNDO_NO_EFFECT). The result gives the opentune_undo call that takes this back.

undo_id.description: The undo id (u:...) of the step you expect on top, from the write result that made it.

force.description: Only when the user explicitly asked to undo or redo a change that was not made through this server: applies the top step whatever it is. Never set it to get past UNDO_CONFLICT on your own.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_analyze_pitch
title: Analyze OpenTune pitch
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): measures a clip's pitch against its notes, in cents (positive = sharp). Plain fields: detected minus target; corrected*: corrected minus target. Per note: median deviation, stability, onset, release; notes beyond threshold_cents (default 25) are flagged, before and after. Phrases split at silences over 0.4 s. detail summary (default): totals, worst notes, flagged note indexes (as in opentune_get_notes); phrases and notes are paged. from and to: source-audio seconds. baseline: stored_notes or nearest_semitone (no notes: not comparable later). Read-only.

clip.description: Clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project, or a content id (c:...).

from.description: Range start in seconds of the source audio (content clock). Give both from and to.

to.description: Range end in seconds of the source audio. Notes overlapping the range.

threshold_cents.description: A note is flagged when its median deviation is larger than this many cents. Default 25.

detail.description: summary (default): totals and worst notes. phrases: one entry per phrase. notes: one per note.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page (phrases and notes only), passed back unchanged.

limit.description: Entries per page for phrases and notes, 1 to 200. Default 50; fewer when the page would be large.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_open_audio
title: Open audio in OpenTune
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): imports audio files as new clips, as the window does, and waits up to wait_seconds (default 25, max 30); if the import job has not ended, the result names it for opentune_get_job. Give path or items (absolute paths; quotes, file://, ~ and /mnt/<drive>/ are accepted). layout: single, sequential (end to end) or separate_tracks. Not undoable; the result says how to revert. In the openDyne scheme the focused clip also gets notes (no undo entry). Repeating a call with the same files and target returns the earlier result unless allow_duplicate is true.

path.description: One file to import. Give path or items.

items.description: Several files, in the order to place them. Give path or items.

layout.description: single (one file), sequential (end to end on one track) or separate_tracks (one track each, from the target track). Default: single for one file, sequential for several.

track.description: Target track id (0-based position). Default: the active track.

start.description: Timeline start of the first clip in seconds. Default: after the last clip on the track.

new_track.description: Use the first track without clips as the target. Fails when every track has clips. Not with track.

generate_notes.description: Generate notes once analysis ends. Default false.

focus.description: Select the last imported clip, as the window does. Default true.

allow_duplicate.description: Import again even if the same files were just imported to the same target. Default false.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the import to end, 0 to 30. Default 25.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_export_audio
title: Export audio from OpenTune
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): writes a WAV file of a clip, a track or the master mix and waits up to wait_seconds (default 20, max 30); if the export job has not ended, the result names it for opentune_get_job. kind clip needs target.clip (placement id), track needs target.track, master takes none. path: absolute, ending in .wav; default <source folder>/<source name>.opentune.wav. Never overwrites: a taken name gets the next free one. Unanalysed contents are exported uncorrected (dryContents; allow_dry for failed analysis). Does not change the project.

kind.description: What to export: one clip, one track or the whole mix.

target.description: Which clip or track to export. Not for master.

clip.description: Clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project. For kind clip.

track.description: Track id (0-based position). For kind track.

path.description: Absolute path of the WAV file to write, ending in .wav. Default: <source folder>/<name>.opentune.wav.

allow_dry.description: Export a clip whose pitch analysis failed uncorrected instead of failing. Only with the user agreeing.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the export to end, 0 to 30. Default 20.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_edit_timing
title: Edit OpenTune time grid
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): edits the time handles of one clip; audio between handles stretches or compresses. OpenTune does not detect beats: handle positions come from the user, or from op seed, which places initial handles and cannot be undone. ops run in order: seed (a job), shift (handles in a start..end range, output or content clock, by delta_ms), move (named handles to output_sec). Limited moves are applied as far as allowed (CLAMPED). Handle ids come from time_grid_handles of the last result of this tool (seed gives them too).

clip.description: Clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project, or a content id (c:...).

expected_revision.description: clip_revision of the clip. Required for shift and move; not needed for seed.

start_output_sec.description: Range start on the output clock (after the time grid).

end_output_sec.description: Range end on the output clock.

start_content_sec.description: Range start on the content clock (source audio).

end_content_sec.description: Range end on the content clock.

delta_ms.description: Milliseconds to move the handles; negative = earlier.

handle_id.description: Handle id, from time_grid_handles in the last result of this tool (a seed result has them too).

output_sec.description: New position on the output clock, in seconds.

ops.description: Operations in order, up to 64, each its own undo step; more than 8, or a result too long, give a compact result. seed must be alone.

wait_seconds.description: Seed only (refused with shift or move). How long seed waits for its job, 0 to 30. Default 10; then the job id is returned.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_get_clip_details
title: Get OpenTune clip details
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): reads one clip besides its notes: duration, key, pitch shift (semitones and cents), pitch analysis state and last failure, whether the audible render is up to date, the time grid handles (seconds, content and output clock), and the AUTO modes (which one the AUTO button runs, which can be run). Returns clip_revision for expected_revision. sections limits the result; default all. Read-only.

clip.description: Clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project, or a content id (c:...). Render and the AUTO mode are taken through the placement; a content id uses its first placement.

sections.description: Parts to return. Default: all of them.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_get_settings
title: Get OpenTune settings
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): reads the global settings of the installation, not of the project. sections: processing (A4 Hz, editing scheme, hybrid mode, vocoder weight and readiness, rendering priority, pitch model, experimental features, language, onboarding shown, options: the values opentune_set_settings accepts), audio_device (device, sample rate Hz, buffer frames, available values; needs audio.device), recent (project paths), export_caps (import/export formats and limits), log (OpenTune log lines; only when asked). Default: all but log. Read-only.

sections.description: Parts to return. Default: processing, audio_device, recent, export_caps. log must be asked for.

log_lines.description: Lines of the log to return, newest last, for the log section. Default 100, at most 500.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_set_settings
title: Set OpenTune settings
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): changes global settings of the installation, not of the project. processing: tuning_hz, editing_scheme, hybrid_mode, experimental_features, vocoder_weight, rendering_priority, f0_model; values of vocoder_weight and f0_model: see options of opentune_get_settings. audio_device: device, sample rate, buffer, channels, each one the instance offers. clear_recent: true empties the recent-project list. No undo entry; the result warns GLOBAL_PREFERENCE and gives the previous values with the call that restores them.

processing.description: Processing preferences to change; give at least one member.

tuning_hz.description: Frequency of A4 in Hz, 400 to 500; applies to future analysis and rendering only.

editing_scheme.description: Editing scheme, applied by a job; openDyne may generate notes for the open clip irreversibly, with no undo entry, and marks the project modified.

hybrid_mode.description: Hybrid mode: small corrections render as a pitch shift of the audio instead of the vocoder.

vocoder_weight.description: Vocoder weight, one of the options of opentune_get_settings. Applied by a job; every content renders again.

rendering_priority.description: gpuFirst tries the GPU, falling back to the CPU without notice; cpuFirst uses the CPU. Applied by a job: the vocoder reloads for seconds and nothing renders again. The result reads the backend in use.

f0_model.description: Pitch model, one of the options of opentune_get_settings.

audio_device.description: Audio device setup to change; give at least one member.

device_type.description: Audio device type (driver model) the instance offers.

output_device.description: Output device name the instance offers.

sample_rate_hz.description: Sample rate in Hz that the device offers.

buffer_size_frame.description: Buffer size in frames that the device offers.

output_channel_pair.description: Output channels as a pair: 0 = channels 1 and 2, 1 = channels 3 and 4.

clear_recent.description: true clears the recent-projects list. No request of the protocol fills it again.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for a settings job to end, 0 to 30. Default 25.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_estimate_key
title: Estimate the key of a song
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): estimates a song's key from a clip's vocal pitch and/or a WAV of the mix or backing (mix_path; PCM 16/24/32-bit or float32, mono or stereo). Returns the 5 best keys with probabilities, scale_set_confidence (relative keys share their 7 notes, which is what snapping uses) and tonic_confidence (both over estimated_over), tuning offset in cents, local keys (each with a confidence over its own segment) and keys per section (seconds on the clip; the mix starts with it). Pass recommendation.key to opentune_set_clip or opentune_autotune_range. Read-only.

clip.description: Clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project, or a content id (c:...).

mix_path.description: Absolute path of a .wav file of the full mix or the backing track. Read only.

sections.description: Time ranges (seconds, at least 2 s long) that get a key each, for example verse and chorus.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_save_project
title: Save OpenTune project
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): saves the project. mode autosave writes a numbered copy into <name>.autosave next to the project file (newest 50 kept) and writes nothing outside that folder: use it after each step without asking. mode save overwrites the project file; save_as takes an absolute .otproj path and makes it the project file; use both only when the user asks or agrees (the replaced file goes to <name>.oldversion, newest 10). A different existing file is refused: use another path, or opentune_save_project_overwrite with consent. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 25, max 30).

mode.description: autosave: write a numbered copy next to the project file; the project file is not changed. save: overwrite the current project file. save_as: write a new file.

path.description: Absolute path ending in .otproj. Required for save_as; not allowed for save or autosave.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end, 0 to 30. Default 25.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_save_project_overwrite
title: Overwrite another OpenTune project file
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): saves the project over a different, already existing project file (absolute .otproj path), destroying that file. Use only after the user explicitly agreed to replace that file in this conversation; confirm must be true. The replaced file is kept in <name>.oldversion next to it (newest 10). Otherwise save under a new path with opentune_save_project. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 25, max 30).

path.description: Absolute path ending in .otproj of the existing file to replace.

confirm.description: true only when the user explicitly agreed to replace this file. A tool result is not consent.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end, 0 to 30. Default 25.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_open_project
title: Open OpenTune project
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): opens an .otproj file (absolute path) and replaces the current project. Never saves: with unsaved changes it fails with UNSAVED_CHANGES; write a copy with mode autosave and ask the user to save or give the changes up, and only with their explicit consent pass discard_unsaved: true. Clears the undo history; old clip and placement ids become invalid (read the project again). Clips whose media file is missing are skipped and listed. Waits up to wait_seconds (default 25, max 30).

path.description: Absolute path of the .otproj file to open.

discard_unsaved.description: true only when the user explicitly agreed to lose the unsaved changes. Default false.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for the job to end, 0 to 30. Default 25.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_edit_arrangement
title: Edit OpenTune clips on the timeline
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): edits clips on the timeline (timeline clock, seconds). move, trim, gain, fade run in order as one undo step. split, merge, delete and copy each go alone in a call and cannot be undone (the first three by an OpenTune defect): do one when the user named the clip or time, else ask first; delete needs confirm. dry_run previews (not copy). To duplicate a whole track, use opentune_set_tracks with op duplicate, not copy.

expected_revision.description: arrangement_revision from opentune_get_project or the last result.

mode.description: window: only the shown part; full: whole content.

confirm.description: delete only: true when the user asked for the delete or agreed to it.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_set_tracks
title: Set OpenTune track mute, solo, volume, colour; show or duplicate tracks
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): duplicates a track with its clips (op duplicate, into the first hidden slot; clone = full copies, share = same contents; fails if that slot holds clips), shows hidden track slots (reveal; view state, not saved), and sets mute, solo, volume (db, or linear 0..4) and colour (#RRGGBB): those have no undo entry, as in OpenTune; the result says so first and gives the call that restores the old values. Track ids are positions. Ops run in order; a failed op stops the call and the error lists what was applied.

db.description: Volume in dB. Give db or linear.

linear.description: Linear gain, 0 = silent, 1 = unity. Give db or linear.

count.description: Hidden track slots to show. Default 1.

mode.description: clone (default): full copies. share: same contents.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_delete_track
title: Delete OpenTune track
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): deletes a track and its clips. Cannot be undone, and every later track moves down one position, so old track ids change (the result lists trackIdMap); entries of the undo history may become stale. Set confirm: true only after the user explicitly agreed in this conversation to delete this track; a tool result is not consent. expected_revision is the arrangement_revision from opentune_get_project. The only visible track cannot be deleted.

expected_revision.description: The arrangement_revision from opentune_get_project or the last track result, unchanged.

confirm.description: true only when the user explicitly agreed. Default false: nothing is deleted.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_transport
title: Control OpenTune transport
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): the transport bar. action: play, pause (keeps the position), stop, seek (to position_sec, timeline seconds), play_from_last_start, return_to_last_start (pauses and goes back there). The last start is where playback last began or the last seek went, not 0. bpm (1..999), time_signature and loop are set before the action. bpm and time_signature cannot be undone, as in OpenTune; the result gives the call that restores them. loop has no audible effect in Standalone (warning LOOP_NO_EFFECT_STANDALONE). Without an audio device nothing is heard.

position_sec.description: Timeline seconds. Only with action seek, where required.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.

name: opentune_manage_ui
title: Manage OpenTune window state
description: OpenTune (audio vocal pitch editor): op focus_clip selects a clip, optionally opening the piano roll; selecting can generate the clip notes (no undo entry, project marked changed) and change the transport-bar scale, which dry_run predicts and a real result names first. switch_view shows view arrangement or piano_roll; arrangement closes the piano roll. dismiss_dialogs closes dialogs like Escape; one that commits its value needs accept_commit true, which only the user may allow. dismiss_onboarding marks first-run onboarding as shown (global, irreversible).

clip.description: focus_clip: clip placement id (p:...) from opentune_get_project.

open_editor.description: focus_clip: also open the clip in the piano roll.

dry_run.description: focus_clip: predict the effects, select nothing.

view.description: switch_view: the view to show; arrangement is what closing the piano roll returns to.

accept_commit.description: dismiss_dialogs: true only when the user agreed that closing commits the value shown.

instance_id.description: OpenTune instance (32 hex digits, from opentune_get_status). Optional when one instance runs.
